businessSection.title: Become one of Autorell's first partner dealers
body: We are selecting a limited number of vehicle dealers who can connect their existing inventory to Autorell at no cost during the pilot period.
Autorell imports your inventory, keeps prices and stock status automatically updated, and gives you statistics for exposure, clicks and customer enquiries.
When the partnership begins to create documented commercial value, we will work with you on a separate agreement for continued cooperation.
benefits: No commitment during the pilot period
A separate commercial agreement only after value has been created
businessSection.availabilityNote: A limited number of companies will be accepted into the first pilot round.

pilotPage.metaDescription: Apply to connect your vehicle inventory to Autorell with free onboarding, automatic synchronisation and no automatic paid subscription.
pilotPage.heroTitle: Connect your vehicle inventory at no cost
pilotPage.heroIntro: Autorell is looking for selected vehicle dealers for a free pilot programme. We connect your existing inventory, keep the listings automatically updated and measure the results together with you.
pilotPage.includedIntro: The first connection is designed to be practical, measurable and free from automatic commercial commitments.
included: Import of your existing vehicle inventory
Automatic synchronisation of new, changed and removed vehicles
No commitment during the pilot period

steps.title: Send your application
steps.text: Your company submits a short application with information about its inventory and preferred connection method.

steps.title: Autorell reviews the company
steps.text: We review the company, its inventory and the technical source before anything is connected.

steps.title: Approve the pilot terms
steps.text: The company approves the pilot terms and confirms its rights to the vehicle data and images.

steps.title: We connect the source
steps.text: Autorell connects the verified website and prepares an import preview. XML, CSV, API and DMS requests go through separate technical onboarding.

steps.title: Inventory is published and kept current
steps.text: Approved listings are published and new, changed or sold vehicles are synchronised safely.

pilotPage.afterLead: The pilot programme does not automatically become a paid subscription.
pilotPage.afterBody: If Autorell can demonstrate relevant traffic, leads or other commercial value, the parties may discuss a separate commercial agreement.
pilotPage.afterNote: No payment, invoice or subscription can start without a new, explicit approval from the company.

faqs.question: Does the pilot programme cost anything?
faqs.answer: No. Technical connection, onboarding, inventory import and automatic synchronisation are free during the agreed pilot period.

faqs.question: Do we need to publish listings manually?
faqs.answer: No. Once the source and preview have been approved, Autorell can create and update the listings from the connected inventory.

faqs.question: What types of inventory can be connected?
faqs.answer: Passenger cars, vans and other supported vehicle categories can be assessed. The exact scope is confirmed during the technical review.

faqs.question: How often is the inventory updated?
faqs.answer: The frequency depends on the source and pilot setup. A daily sync is the normal starting point, with more frequent synchronisation where agreed and technically possible.

faqs.question: What happens when a vehicle is sold?
faqs.answer: A sold or removed vehicle is first confirmed through a successful sync and is then paused or marked as sold. A temporary source outage never removes the whole inventory.

faqs.question: Can several locations be connected?
faqs.answer: Yes. Several locations can be connected when the source data identifies them or when they are mapped during onboarding.

faqs.question: What happens after the pilot period?
faqs.answer: We review the documented results together. Continued cooperation requires a separate agreement accepted by both parties.

faqs.question: Do we automatically become a paying customer?
faqs.answer: No. There is no automatic conversion, payment or subscription after the pilot.

faqs.question: Who owns the listings, images and vehicle data?
faqs.answer: The company retains its rights to its material and confirms that it may provide it for publication. Autorell only receives the rights needed to import, store, display and synchronise it under the pilot terms.

faqs.question: Can we end the pilot project?
faqs.answer: Yes. The pilot can be ended without a subscription commitment. The practical removal of imported material is handled in a controlled way with the company.

form.title: Tell us about your inventory
form.intro: The application does not start an integration or create a paid subscription. Autorell reviews it and contacts the named person first.
